official_value: Not null and void if within annual + banked cap (Rules 4.10(b), 4.12(b))
analysis: README.md asserts that omitting itemization of annual vs. banked portions voids an otherwise correct increase. Enacted SF Rent Board Rules 4.10(b) and 4.12(b) explicitly provide that failure to include banking breakdown dates/portions does NOT render the increase null and void so long as total rent requested does not exceed lawful annual + banked limits (though itemization remains essential to pass lawyer review).
